'''Marillin Gemalphin''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Brown Ajah]]. She is also [[Black Ajah]]{{ref/book|3|13}} and one of [[Liandrin's Group of Black Sisters|Liandrin's group of Black sisters]].

== Appearance and Personality==
She is skinny, with dreamy blue eyes and lifeless brown hair. She has a narrow face{{ref/book|4|38}}.

She loves cats and other animals, quite possibly more than she likes people, going out of her way to [[Healing|Heal]] stray cats.{{ref/book|3|25}}

==Strength and Abilities==
Marillin is [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|strong]] in the One Power for an Aes Sedai, with a strength level of {{opsl|21}}. Among thirteen sisters that fled with Liandrin, only Liandrin is stronger, although [[Eldrith Jhondar]] is only slightly weaker. When the much weaker [[Temaile Kinderode]] calls her a fool, Marillin is quick to reminder her who should stand higher among them, a fact observed by [[Elayne Trakand]].{{ref/book|11|31}}

She would be strong enough to [[Traveling|Travel]]. While it is not certain if she knows the weave, her disappearance from Caemlyn and the spread of knowledge among the Black Ajah would point to her having it available to her.

She has the Talent of [[Healing]].

== History ==
Marillin is from [[Caemlyn]] [[Andor]].{{ref/book|11|31}}

She is 152 years old. She was born in {{ne|848}} and went to the [[White Tower]] in {{ne|863}}. After spending six years as a [[novice]] and five years as [[Accepted]], she was raised to the [[shawl]] in {{ne|874}}.

She could be in the same heart as [[Careane Fransi]], for it is Marillin who reveals the [[Green Ajah|Green]]'s true identity as [[Black Ajah]].{{ref/book|9|10}}

==Activities==
=== Fleeing the White Tower ===
After fleeing the White Tower in Liandrin's group, she went to [[Tear]] and worked for the [[Forsaken]] [[Be'lal]]. They tried to trap [[Rand al'Thor]] just after he released ''[[Callandor]]''. 

Marillin and the others travel to [[Tanchico]] to try and steal the [[Domination Band|male ''a'dam'']] from the [[Panarch]]'s [[Panarch's Palace|Palace]].{{ref/book|4|38}} This plan was also foiled by [[Elayne Trakand]] and [[Nynaeve al'Meara]].{{ref/book|4|54}} The group flee the aftermath of this confrontation and the increasing chaos in Tarabon and cross the border into [[Amadicia]]. 

After [[Moghedien]] reappears in Amadicia takes control of the group, she gives Marillin a secret mission unknown to the others and the reader.{{ref/book|5|18}}. She was sent [[Caemlyn]], her home city, first hinted at by a prevalent rumour of an Aes Sedai Healing cats, a known fondness of Marillin's.{{ref/book|6|41}} 

=== Elayne's kidnap ===
While in Caemlyn, she was put under the command of [[Lady Shiaine]] and resided in the house on Full Moon Street.{{ref|{{twotc|Marillin Gemalphin}}}} The timing of this is unknown as Shiaine was in [[Ebou Dar]] sometime after Marillin's initial commission, although it is possible Shiaine made this trip afterwards. Regardless, Marillin first attempted to put herself in control of the situation, or at least to resist taking orders, but [[Falion Bhoda]]'s punishment made her realise that taking orders was in her best interest.{{ref|{{twotc|Marillin Gemalphin}}}} By [[The Path of Daggers]], she and Shiaine are taking orders from [[Moridin]].{{ref/book|8|10}}

Marillin was ordered by Shiaine to find a way to infiltrate the Royal Palace. Marillin tells Shiaine that she cannot do what she wants, because the Palace is full of female channellers, but that there is a woman already in the Royal Palace who can.{{ref/book|9|10}}

She was later involved in the unsuccessful kidnap attempt on Elayne and so she was captured.{{ref/book|11|31}}{{ref/book|11|32}} When in Caemlyn she had heard about a woman Warder, but told nothing to the others.

===Unforeseen rescue===
In an attempt to interrogate a member of the Black Ajah, Elayne impersonates a Forsaken and in the process gets herself into a lot of trouble. [[Doilin Mellar]], whom she believes to be a Queen's man but is really a [[Darkfriend]], assaults her. Timely intervention by [[Matrim Cauthon]] and [[Birgitte Silverbow]] saves Elayne from further harm, but Mellar escapes.{{ref/book|13|24}}

During the fight between Elayne and Mellar, Marillin and Falion were probably freed from the dungeons by [[Jaq Lounalt]].

===The [[Last Battle]]===
Marillin's fate is unknown, but it can be presumed that she fought in the Last Battle and was either killed or captured, or is on the run.
